The twelve Units of Klasse 9 (E) across the school
year. Each Unit covers roughly three teaching weeks.

| Unit | Title | Skills focus | Exam type |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------|
| 1 | [Future Careers](units/unit01_future-careers.qmd) | reading, speaking, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 2 | [Money and Choices](units/unit02_money-and-choices.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 3 | [The Environment, Locally](units/unit03_the-environment-locally.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 4 | [Canada: Perspectives](units/unit04_canada-perspectives.qmd) | reading, writing, intercultural | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 5 | [Media Literacy](units/unit05_media-literacy.qmd) | reading, listening, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 6 | [Interview and Portrait](units/unit06_interview-and-portrait.qmd) | speaking, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 7 | [Mediation: A German News Article](units/unit07_mediation-news-article.qmd) | mediation, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 8 | [Inequality and Voice](units/unit08_inequality-and-voice.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 9 | [Short Fiction in the Classroom](units/unit09_short-fiction.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 10 | [Writing an Application Letter](units/unit10_application-letter.qmd) | reading, writing, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 11 | [Debate and Discussion](units/unit11_debate-and-discussion.qmd) | speaking, listening, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
| 12 | [Year Review: Portfolio](units/unit12_year-review-portfolio.qmd) | writing, speaking, language_awareness | class test (Klassenarbeit) |
